options.name: Sports Editorial
options.prompt:
Create a production-quality desktop web dashboard mockup for Tapua'i Sports, a Polynesian-inspired sports community. Target frame 1440 x 1024, app content only, no browser chrome or device frame. Audience: the owner and staff reviewing donation activity and Highlights. Use a distinctive and intentional visual composition, strong typography and precise alignment. Existing palette: warm daylight canvas #f6f8f7, white #ffffff, ink #10161a, soft ink #4a5560, jade #00733c, cyan #00707e, gold #8a6400, violet #4c1d95. Donations always jade, clips always cyan, attention gold; red only for genuine failures. Use no more than two fonts, readable 14–16px body copy and restrained small labels. Prefer whitespace, editorial grouping and thin dividers; avoid making every item a rounded card, repeated eight-tile grids, cards inside cards, decorative gradients and generic SaaS dashboard tropes.
This is a redesign concept of an existing read-only admin Home. Preserve navigation: Home / Trends / Audience / Revenue / Health / Product, with Analytics and Departments as secondary links. Keep the header in normal document flow. Main action: View Trends, linking to the existing Trends page. All metrics below are SYNTHETIC SAMPLE DATA; show a discreet 'Sample data · 06–12 Oct 2026' label. Date anchor today Monday 12 October 2026. Dates cover Tuesday 6 through Monday 12 October, not the coming week.
Core values: Donations $3,182 across 162 donation records in the last 7 days, prior week $2,749, +16% versus prior week; Clips uploaded 214, prior week 181, +18%; average donation $19.64. Secondary only if room: Tab opens 6,120 in 24h (events, not distinct people). No invented users, conversion, retention, family counts or acquisition rates. No rankings tying donation success to athlete performance. Money words are Donate/donation; do not use 'tips' or 'backing'.
Donation series: Tue 6 $381, Wed 7 $524, Thu 8 $299, Fri 9 $417.50, Sat 10 $663, Sun 11 $482.50, Mon 12 $415. Clip series: 24,31,28,19,42,33,37 across those same days. Use separate readable scales; never combine dollars and clip counts into one misleading axis. Data summaries and unobtrusive 'Data' disclosures should have plausible places. No images of actual people, sponsor logos, real customer details or random Polynesian ornamental patterns. Keep one dominant use case: understand the week, then examine Trends. The remaining product exists beyond this screen. The attached image is the current Tapua'i admin Home screenshot from /Users/seiuliian/Downloads/ala-sports. Use it as the actual product reference for branding, navigation, read-only status, available data and metric meanings. Recompose the hierarchy according to the art direction instead of copying its repeated tile grid. Keep an ADMIN · READ ONLY identifier and a Sign out utility. Replace raw RPC/function status badges with quiet, plain-language data freshness text and a Data disclosure. Keep the screen useful as an admin dashboard.
ART DIRECTION — SPORTS EDITORIAL: Compose the page like a premium sports publication's data desk. Use an oversized typographic headline 'The week, in motion.' and a bold donation total as the visual anchor. One wide, beautifully plotted donation trend dominates the composition. Give the clip story an asymmetric narrower column with restrained cyan bars and a sharp '214 clips' label. Set average donation and 162 donation records as a compact typographic footnote row rather than individual tiles. White/daylight surface, strong jade editorial rule, generous margins, squared geometry, very few outlines and no drop-shadow card grid. Make the date and prior-week annotation work as an editorial deck. Branded and quietly confident; sophisticated sports energy.
